newsitem.title: UK: British Biotech dismisses Shield bid report.
newsitem.headline: British Biotech dismisses Shield bid report.

text.p: British Biotechnology Plc on Wednesday dismissed a report in the Times newspaper that it might be planning a 10.00 stg per share bid for Shield Diagnostics Plc.

A spokesman for British Biotech said there was "no truth" in the story, adding the company was not looking at an acquisition of the size of Shield -- which would be valued at 193 million stg at the bid price mentioned in the Times report.
"It is certainly not something the company is looking at," the spokesman said.
Shield shares were unchanged at 452-1/2 by 0847 GMT, after earlier rising as much as 37-1/2p on the back of the bid story.
British Biotech shares were unchanged at 257-1/2p.
